This yields a materially denser and more advanced RED (9 units: 6 air, 2 subsurface, 1 surface) against a leaner BLUE (7 units: 3 surface, 2 air, 2 subsurface), matching tier 5's asymmetric-joint-mix / dense-red spec while isolating the platform-swap-underused mutation dimension only -- no cascading-inject, ROE-change, or contested-EM recipe layered on top (those are this run's other tier-5 candidate lanes, e.g. this run's sibling event-cascading-adversarial candidate). BLUE stays WeaponsTight (restrained, consistent with the tier-4 winner's convention) against RED's WeaponsFree stance, so detections span AAW (Eurofighter/MiG-31/Su-35S/Su-34 radar contacts, with su-57-felon modeled at reduced basePd for 5th-gen low-observability), ASW (BLUE SSN/SSK vs RED's quieter SSGN/AIP-SSK), and surface cross-cueing (flagship-vs-frigate radar) concurrently within one ORBAT across the full 40-tick tier-5 budget.
